about: The twelve shipped Locator.X editions as published, with the sha256 and byte size of the exact HTML served at each edition's artifact URL on 2026-09-11. Four carry `records_measured`: their record stores were counted live by driving the published artifact in headless Chromium, matching the 2026-09-09 verification in docs/PUBLISH_MAP.md exactly. The other eight were fetched and title-verified only, and say so rather than borrowing a count they did not earn. This file is the publish channel's integrity manifest (scripts/publish_editions.sh ↔ scripts/build_editions_index.py) and the dashboard's source of truth.
